problem: Two dense diagonal point-bands appear in the re-plot that are the fitted trend lines sampled as data, while the actual triangle marker series are mostly missed.
suggested_fix: Suppress fit/trend lines (long thin diagonal strokes) before sampling and prioritize discrete marker glyphs as the data series.

problem: Data points lie correctly on markers but the legend invents spurious series ('o','^') instead of the three real labels (Narrow, Broad, Non-detections).
suggested_fix: Map extracted color/marker clusters to the parsed legend entries rather than emitting raw glyph-shape placeholders.

problem: The original x-axis is logarithmic but the re-plot renders it linear (0-5), and 6 series are emitted where the chart has 3.
suggested_fix: Detect log x-axis from tick labels and calibrate accordingly; merge duplicate color series down to the legend count.

problem: The flat pink 10^-11 series is split into scattered orange/green points so series-to-legend assignment is wrong even though curve shapes are recovered.
suggested_fix: Improve color clustering so a single flat horizontal series is not fragmented across multiple legend colors.

problem: The original y-axis appears log/color-coded but the re-plot is linear, and an extra pink point cluster near the bottom does not match the original marks.
suggested_fix: Re-derive the y-axis scale from tick labels and drop the spurious low-value cluster that has no corresponding marker.

problem: Scatter structure is recovered but legend shows raw glyph placeholders ('o','+') and the blue SFG cross series is partly mislabeled.
suggested_fix: Bind extracted clusters to parsed text legend labels (SFG, LRD) instead of glyph-shape tokens.

problem: Original x-axis is log with a trailing '1' tick; the re-plot is linear (0.0075-0.025) and far-left/far-right points are dropped.
suggested_fix: Parse log tick labels including the anomalous trailing tick and extend the x-range to include all extracted markers.

problem: Original marks cluster near top (~1) and bottom (~0) but the re-plot spreads points continuously across the full y-range, suggesting y-calibration drift.
suggested_fix: Verify y-axis tick mapping; the strip plot's two-level structure should be preserved rather than smeared.

problem: The four model series are recovered but legend labels are truncated/duplicated ('log(fH, lim) =') and the HeCS/CHANCES/WEAVE survey markers are not captured as separate series.
suggested_fix: Fix legend text parsing of subscripted math labels and add the three single-marker survey points as distinct series.

problem: Only the dense power-law line is reconstructed; the five distinct colored survey markers (square, diamond, triangle, plus, x) sitting on the line are not output as separate data.
suggested_fix: Detect discrete colored marker glyphs overlapping a line and emit them as separate series rather than absorbing into the line.

problem: The original y-axis is logarithmic (10^2-10^3) but the re-plot renders it linear (0-1000), distorting the curve spacing.
suggested_fix: Detect log y-axis from the 10^n tick labels and calibrate values in log space.

problem: The red model track is recovered well but the colored photometry marker series (squares and up/down triangles) are nearly all missed and the legend emits a stray '^' label.
suggested_fix: Strengthen filled-marker detection for triangles/squares so the photometry series are extracted alongside the track.

problem: The dense purple line (a reddening vector) plus a few stray points are output, while the prominent blue evolutionary track and most of the 10 labeled marker series are lost.
suggested_fix: Treat the reddening/guide line as non-data, and recover the blue track curve and the per-object colored markers as the real series.

problem: All five model curves are extracted accurately but two legend labels are garbled ('9 [ln(1)+ 3', 'exp[ 3( +4/3)2') from broken math-text parsing.
suggested_fix: Improve LaTeX/math legend text extraction so subscripted and bracketed expressions are not mangled.
